This draft addresses #784 by removing supported routed geolocation fields and ingress identity headers by default, with explicit per-request consent through `x-router-share-geolocation: true`. Consent is validated and stripped before forwarding. Provider, retry, streaming, management, persistence and supported WebSocket paths retain regression coverage. Prompts and application data are preserved.

Reproduce by sending a supported inference request containing location fields and ingress forwarding headers, first without consent and then with one valid consent header. Automated regressions are `parity/fixtures/server/geolocation.test.mjs` and `parity/fixtures/server/geolocation-websocket.test.mjs`, included in the complete native server suite. Direct traffic, source-IP visibility, account settings, OAuth/MCP and tool-specific settings remain unresolved. The [case study](https://github.com/link-assistant/router/blob/issue-784-1f6838f56841/docs/case-studies/issue-784/README.md) maps all requirements, research and limitations.

The coordinated repair batch retains exact struct-ordering and Clone histories, removes discarded namespace-copy allocations and bounds private builtin lexical DATA storage. Every caller still receives independent mutable token data, and original callbacks, private issuers, source inverses and independent semantic checks remain required. The actual isolated registration producer joins all 1,944 complete inputs and genuine Git history. All 32 original portable/isolated cases pass across Node and Bun; both Node deadline audits pass. Two subsequent derivation drafts failed unchanged deadlines and were withdrawn. These source repairs establish no new executable production-function count. See the [lexical report](https://github.com/link-assistant/router/blob/issue-784-1f6838f56841/docs/case-studies/issue-784/builtin-lexical-storage-20261111.md) and [registration report](https://github.com/link-assistant/router/blob/issue-784-1f6838f56841/docs/case-studies/issue-784/builtin-lexical-registration-20261111.md).

Published `beda7848b29a499f5cf3d1a7792d7353e62f12ca` has finished its entire CI cycle: 75 jobs, comprising 23 failed, eight cancelled, 19 passed and 25 skipped. All 30 available nonpassing logs, the full available workflow ZIP and 40 selected deadline artifacts were inspected. Translation-13's cancelled log is unavailable; the separate bulk artifact remains uninspected. The [terminal review](https://github.com/link-assistant/router/blob/issue-784-1f6838f56841/docs/case-studies/issue-784/ci-beda-terminal-20261111.md) records exact errors and 34 genuine original Node deadline breaches. This feedback checkpoint does not claim that the full failure set is repaired.

The complete local gate at source `8aa6deb90ca36b5f129bdb78e44f78e782cdf0d2` passes all ten lint commands, all 260 native Node cases, all 260 native Bun cases, all ten deadline-auditor controls, public/native strict TypeScript, native regeneration freshness and strict compilation of 167 generated native files. All nine native TypeScript assertions pass, but the independent audit fails regeneration at 90598.061608 ms against its unchanged 60000 ms deadline. The final complete runtime fixture case passes at 222094.092534/300000 ms. Nine later TypeScript commands remain unrun.

During parity acceptance, new audit evidence exceeded the 500 MB task cap by about 1 MB. The owned gate was stopped, all children exited, every complete stream was archived and verified, and exact duplicate retirement restored evidence below the cap. Strict parity, forward/reverse stages and final fingerprint remain unrun; no green stamp exists. The [complete gate report](https://github.com/link-assistant/router/blob/issue-784-1f6838f56841/docs/case-studies/issue-784/current-8aa-complete-gate.md) records the interruption, temporary preservation peak and all 93 verified members. The later documentation checkpoint has no separate green gate. Toolchain: Node 20.20.2, lockfile TypeScript 5.9.3, local Bun 1.4.4; CI pins Bun 1.4.3.

Strict parity remains unfinished: 441 draft gaps, 12426 carried Rust items, stale canonical outputs, incomplete owned/profile generation and private compiler admission remain blocking. The complete compiler census has 344 modules, 343 original files and 4704748 raw bytes, exceeding the unchanged 4194304-byte bound by 510444 bytes. Inventory counts and preserved source grant no executable authority. Original deadlines and source budgets are unchanged.

Latest fetched `main`, `eb2dad1c0a18394dc1aad46413e11401e74eb502`, is already an ancestor. No missing secret or access grant explains these failures; no human-action skip is introduced. Every required JavaScript stage must pass for the same SHA before any Rust job starts. No local Rust tool ran. All remaining CI, generation, parity and privacy criteria must be completed before readiness or merge.

Fixes #784
